Blind but telepathic, he attacks the pup with F; each touch that slimes it (1 in 4) lets it breathe fire on itself instead of turning into slime. Whenever the pup's bites end his slime form he polymorphs again. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
